title: Choose the swarm demonstration and worker ownership
description: Choose between Arsune-operated worker agents under one marketplace service and paid subcontracting to another provider. Confirm whether the supplier-data task in README remains the first demonstration. Use docs/DECISIONS.md. This changes spending authority, source sharing, scope, and the AI Swarms demonstration.
acceptance_criteria: Record the selected worker ownership model and one concrete demonstration task. For external hiring, define the buyer identity, provider, spending cap, permitted source data, and deadline before implementation.

title: Build the swarm activity and evidence demonstration
description: Add the Next.js operator interface for task assignment, worker progress, corrections, source evidence, uncertainty, and cost. Present one complete job and the measured comparison. Keep publication as a separate submission action.
acceptance_criteria: Run a browser check of a successful job and a rejected-then-corrected job. Show unresolved evidence honestly and demonstrate restart recovery. UI and report state match persisted records; sources are accessible only to the permitted viewer; demo labels identify simulation versus real calls.

title: Prepare and review the first demonstration dataset
description: After the task choice, prepare synthetic sources, reference answers, and separate development and held-out cases. Follow RULES.md for the supplier-task candidate, or replace those rules for the selected task. Obtain a person review of the answers before calling them reviewed.
acceptance_criteria: Source provenance and expected values are recorded; normal, missing, conflicting, omitted, malformed, and instruction-bearing cases are covered; development and held-out cases are separate; a person confirms the reference answers.

title: Measure real agents against the single-worker baseline
description: Add a NEAR AI Cloud model connection behind the existing scripted interface. Compare the selected worker and checker setup with a single-worker baseline on the same reviewed held-out dataset. Enable live calls only with a configured spend ceiling.
acceptance_criteria: Record model and prompt versions, field accuracy, row recall, missed errors, false rejections, raw counts, time, and actual or uncertain cost. Execute real calls within the configured cap. Publish measured results without claiming an unmeasured swarm benefit.

title: Implement and verify the marketplace seller connection
description: Implement docs/MARKET_INTEGRATION.md: assignment polling with pagination, sources, start, feedback, upload and complete, submission, and remote-state reconciliation. Keep the worker token outside model inputs. Use synthetic or public data for the first authorized live test. External hiring is a separate extension only if selected.
acceptance_criteria: Contract tests exercise current request shapes and recovery after ambiguous submission. With an authorized account and bounded test budget, verify source download through submission, requested changes, cancellation, and status observation. Test artifact access and distinguish submission, acceptance, and confirmed payout. Do not call a mock a live integration.

title: Implement the swarm workflow with a repeatable simulation
description: Use the same coordinator and records for scripted and real modes. Demonstrate two worker assignments, original-source checking, coverage checking, one bounded correction, review expiry, and budget limits. Enforce RULES.md and preserve attempt history.
acceptance_criteria: Offline scenarios cover correct work, wrong evidence, omitted rows, missing and conflicting values, source errors, embedded instructions, repeat tasks, and exhausted limits. Run the simulation and verify exact expected states and outputs with network calls disabled.

title: Build the FastAPI service and recoverable Python worker
description: Implement the common architecture in docs/ARCHITECTURE.md: FastAPI, Pydantic, PostgreSQL, Celery and Redis, private file access, stored pending actions, and worker leases. Use one Python package with separate API, coordinator, and worker processes. Pin compatible dependencies after a real installation check.
acceptance_criteria: A real API request creates an owned job; a real worker completes a task; database-to-queue interruption and worker restart recover; repeat delivery and stale leases cannot overwrite results; cross-owner reads are denied; build, type checks, and relevant integration tests run.

title: Confirm Agent Market integration and first dataset task
description: Review the current Agent Market API, payment and acceptance flow, and test options. Select one supplier document type and a reviewed reference dataset. Define acceptance rules and review deadlines before implementation. See README.md for the agreed project context.
notes: Public seller API, file delivery, acceptance behavior, and test options are reviewed in docs/MARKET_INTEGRATION.md. Architecture and proposed rules are recorded. Still open: choose worker ownership and the demonstration task, then prepare person-reviewed reference answers and confirm acceptance rules. No live API or model test has been run.

title: Record swarm architecture and marketplace findings
description: Prepare the FastAPI architecture, agent roles, task and evidence formats, correction rules, recovery design, and current Agent Market findings. Keep unresolved product choices explicit. Update README without claiming an implemented system.
acceptance_criteria: Architecture and rules are consistent; current public API shapes are checked; scope choices and live-test limits are recorded; documentation links and beads dependencies are checked; changes are committed and pushed.
close_reason: Recorded FastAPI architecture, task and evidence formats, workflow rules, marketplace API findings, and the remaining scope choice. Checked local links, issue references, whitespace, and dependency cycles. Documentation and task records are ready for the required commit and push.
